Mechanism: service recommendation was changed recently and breaks deployment/recommendation, which it acts on.

Observed impact: deployment `recommendation` in namespace `astronomy-shop`.
Evidence:
- service recommendation fields written: spec.internalTrafficPolicy
- service recommendation has internalTrafficPolicy=Local: only endpoints on the client's own node receive traffic
- service recommendation (internalTrafficPolicy=Local) has ready endpoints only on kind-worker; client deployment/frontend runs on kind-worker2, where calls to recommendation find no local endpoint
- Service recommendation was modified 191s ago, 71s after it was created (fields: spec.internalTrafficPolicy); 50s before the first active symptom
- deployment/recommendation: service recommendation has internalTrafficPolicy=Local: only endpoints on the client's own node receive traffic
